main.description: Fetches and parses a link preview. The AppView fetches the URL on the client's behalf, so the client's address is never exposed to the target site.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: The request has no valid service auth.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The arguments are inconsistent or malformed beyond schema validation.

errors.name: NotFetchable
errors.description: The target refused the request, timed out, or resolves to an address the AppView will not fetch.

errors.name: UpstreamFailure
errors.description: The target site failed while the AppView fetched or parsed it.
